decision.reasoning_trace: Customer is looking for a mechanical keyboard, so we considered products that are complete keyboards. We filtered out keycap sets, keyboard cables, and individual switches. Our consideration set includes the Ganss ALT 71, Alkem Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, Hexgears Impulse, E-Yooso 60% Retro Steampunk, and ASUS ROG Falchion. We chose the Hexgears Impulse as the final choice because of its high rating and positive reviews. Many reviewers praised its durability, clicky switches, and NKRO support, making it an excellent option for gaming and typing.
